page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding 2.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance profile characterized by average multi-core capabilities alongside weak single-core performance. The single-core stress-ng and Geekbench scores fall into the bottom 25% tier, and single-threaded gzip compression is in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-threaded operations demonstrate average performance, with the stress-ng multi-core CPU test, Geekbench multi-core test, and Passmark CPU score all ranking in the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks also register average performance, though the Passmark memory score is weak.

Given the 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio, this instance is structured for compute-focused workloads that do not require high memory density or local storage. It is suitable for multi-threaded applications such as software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations, where parallel processing can offset the weaker single-core performance. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the use of older Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors provides a dedicated resource pool at a lower qualitative cost tier compared to newer generation hardware, though it presents a tradeoff in single-threaded efficiency.
